unit.label: Work, after-events & easy/hard actions
unit.title: Is That Job Easy to Find?
unit.description: Complete this lesson with the conversation: work and business, returning home, Event + 以後, finding a job, trying, and the special 好/難 + verb patterns.

banner.text: 這樣的工作在你們國家好找嗎
banner.pinyin: Zhèyàng de gōngzuò zài nǐmen guójiā hǎo zhǎo ma

goal.text: 我回國以後，也想找個有機會說中文的工作。
goal.pinyin: Wǒ huíguó yǐhòu, yě xiǎng zhǎo ge yǒu jīhuì shuō Zhōngwén de gōngzuò.
goal.meaning: After I go back home, I would also like to find a job with opportunities to speak Chinese.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 12 「你在臺灣學多久的中文？」 Dialogue II / Vocabulary II (printed pp. 249–251), Grammar III 以後 (printed pp. 255–257), and Grammar IV 好/難 + verbs (printed pp. 257–259). This unit completes Lesson 12. Unit 35 already taught standalone 以後 'in the future'; this unit adds Event/Time + 以後 'after/later' and the source 好/難 + verb distinctions.

lessons.title: When Did You Come to Work?
lessons.subtitle: Learn 工作 and 去年 while retrieving the past-event 是…的 question from Unit 35.

steps.prompt: In 去年，我已經在臺灣工作一年了, what does 工作 mean?
steps.explanation: 工作 is a verb here: Tianzhong says he has been working in Taiwan.

steps.prompt: Which word means “last year”?
steps.explanation: 去年 means last year.

steps.prompt: this lesson lists 工作 both as a verb and as a noun. Which pair is correct?
steps.explanation: The same written word 工作 is used in the conversation both for the activity 'to work' and for a job/work.

lessons.title: Doing Business in Taiwan
lessons.subtitle: Use 生意 in 做生意 and understand why the company wants its staff to speak Chinese.

steps.prompt: What does 生意 mean in 做生意?
steps.explanation: 做生意 means to do business; 生意 is the new noun 'business'.

steps.prompt: Why does Tianzhong's company want the staff to speak Chinese?
options: The company does business with Taiwanese people.
The company is a language school.
The staff are all university students.
steps.answer: The company does business with Taiwanese people.
steps.explanation: the conversation says 因為我們公司跟臺灣人做生意, so the business relationship motivates the language study.

steps.prompt: In 老闆希望我們都會說中文, what does 希望 mean?
steps.explanation: 希望 is review vocabulary. The line says the boss wants everyone to be able to speak Chinese.

lessons.title: After You Go Home
lessons.subtitle: Learn Event/Time + 以後 'after/later' and contrast it with Unit 35's standalone 以後 'in the future'.

steps.prompt: What does 回國以後 mean?
steps.explanation: With an event before it, 以後 means 'after': 回國 + 以後.

steps.prompt: Where does 以後 go when it means 'after an event'?
options: only at the very end of the whole sentence
steps.explanation: The anchor comes first: 回國以後, 來臺灣以後, 下課以後.

steps.prompt: Which use of 以後 was already taught in Unit 35?
options: standalone 以後 = in the future
Event + 以後 = before an event
steps.answer: standalone 以後 = in the future
steps.explanation: Unit 35 taught 以後 as a standalone future time word. This unit adds the post-event 'after/later' use.

lessons.title: Is That Kind of Job Easy to Find?
lessons.subtitle: Learn 難, 這樣, and 國家, then distinguish the special 好/難 + verb meanings.

steps.prompt: What does 這樣的工作 mean?
steps.explanation: 這樣 means 'this kind (of)' or 'like this'; 的 links it to 工作.

steps.prompt: In 好找, what does 好 mean?
steps.explanation: With an action verb such as 找, 好 means 'easy to do': 好找 = easy to find.

steps.prompt: Which word means “country”?
steps.explanation: 國家 is the lesson noun for country.

steps.prompt: Which sentence uses the perception-verb branch of 好 + verb?
options: 這樣的工作在你們國家好找嗎？
steps.explanation: With perception verbs such as 吃/喝/看/聽, the rule here treats forms like 好吃 as single words describing a pleasant perception.

lessons.title: Give It a Try
lessons.subtitle: Learn 試 and the phrase 試試看, while practicing 好不好 + verb questions.

steps.prompt: What does 試 mean?
steps.explanation: 試 is 'to try'. 試試看 is the phrase 'give it a try / try and see what happens'.

steps.prompt: What is 好不好找 asking?
options: whether it is easy to find
steps.answer: whether it is easy to find
steps.explanation: 好不好 + action verb is an A-not-A question: 好不好找 asks whether something is easy to find.

lessons.title: What If It Is Hard to Find?
lessons.subtitle: Learn 那麼, finish the conversation, and practice negatives/questions across both 好/難 + verb branches.

steps.prompt: What does 難 mean before an action verb?
steps.explanation: 難 + action verb means that the action is difficult: 難找 = hard to find, 難學 = hard to learn.

steps.prompt: What does 那麼 mean in 那麼我再來臺灣學中文?
steps.explanation: Here 那麼 introduces the consequence or next response: 'then / in that case'.

steps.prompt: Which negative follows the pattern taught here?
steps.explanation: Negation places 不 before the 好/難 + verb predicate: 不好找, 不難學, 不好喝.

steps.prompt: Which A-not-A form matches the perception-verb pattern taught here?
options: 你覺得那個電影好看不好看？
你覺得那個電影好看不看？
你覺得那個電影好不看？
steps.answer: 你覺得那個電影好看不好看？
steps.explanation: For the perception word 好看, the rule here A-not-A example repeats the whole compound: 好看不好看.

lessons.title: Unit 36 Review
lessons.subtitle: Retrieve the conversation, both new grammar systems, all eight new lexical items, and the four new characters.

steps.prompt: Listen for the word for work.
steps.audioText: 去年，我已經在臺灣工作一年了。
steps.explanation: 工作 is the word for working here.

steps.prompt: Listen for the phrase meaning 'give it a try'.
steps.audioText: 不知道好不好找，我試試看。

steps.prompt: Listen for 'hard to find'.
steps.audioText: 要是難找呢？那麼我再來臺灣學中文。
steps.explanation: 難找 means hard to find.

steps.prompt: 工作 can mean which pair in this lesson?
steps.explanation: the vocabulary set lists 工作 twice with verb and noun uses.

steps.prompt: 去年 means…
steps.explanation: 去年 is last year.

steps.prompt: 生意 means…
steps.explanation: 生意 is business; 做生意 means to do business.

steps.prompt: 這樣 means…
steps.explanation: 這樣 describes something as being 'this kind' or 'like this'.

steps.prompt: 國家 means…
steps.explanation: 國家 means country.

steps.prompt: 試 means…
steps.explanation: 試 is 'to try'; 試試看 is 'give it a try'.

steps.prompt: 難 before an action verb means…
steps.explanation: 難找 is hard to find; 難學 is hard to learn.

steps.prompt: 那麼 in the conversation means…
steps.explanation: 那麼 introduces what follows from the situation.

steps.prompt: Which means 'after returning home'?
steps.explanation: Event + 以後 means after that event.

steps.prompt: In 半年以後，你打算做什麼？, what does 半年以後 mean?
steps.explanation: A time expression can come before 以後 just like an event anchor: 半年以後 means half a year later.

steps.prompt: How does Unit 35's standalone 以後 differ from 回國以後?
options: Standalone 以後 means 'in the future'; 回國以後 means 'after returning home'.
They always mean exactly the same thing.
steps.answer: Standalone 以後 means 'in the future'; 回國以後 means 'after returning home'.
steps.explanation: this lesson explicitly distinguishes these two functions.

steps.prompt: Which sentence correctly puts 很 before a perception word?
steps.explanation: The source shows that degree adverbs such as 很 can modify this branch: 很好吃.

steps.prompt: Which pair belongs to the perception branch taught here?
steps.explanation: With perception verbs, forms such as 好吃/難吃, 好喝/難喝, 好看/難看, 好聽/難聽 function as perception descriptions.

steps.prompt: Which sentence correctly negates a 難 + perception word?
steps.explanation: Put 不 before the whole perception word. The uses 不難吃 here to mean the cafeteria food is not bad to eat / tastes okay.

steps.prompt: Which A-not-A question asks whether the dessert taught today is hard to learn to make?
options: 老師今天教的甜點難不難學？
老師今天教的甜點難不學？
老師今天教的甜點不難學難？
steps.answer: 老師今天教的甜點難不難學？
steps.explanation: The uses 難不難 + action verb here: 難不難學 asks whether it is difficult to learn to make the dessert.

steps.prompt: Which question correctly retrieves Unit 35's 是…的 pattern?
options: 你是什麼時候來臺灣工作的？
你什麼是時候來臺灣工作？
steps.answer: 你是什麼時候來臺灣工作的？
steps.explanation: The the conversation opening retrieves the past-event focus/question construction.

工.note: 工 is first-tone gōng. It is the first character of 工作, the this lesson word for both 'to work' and 'job/work'.
工.memory: A top line, a central vertical, and a longer base make a simple workbench-like 工.

parts.label: 工
parts.name: whole 工 form
parts.description: All three strokes form the simple, indivisible learner shape of 工.

作.note: 作 is fourth-tone zuò. In 工作 it combines with 工 to form 'work'; do not confuse it with the already-known 做, which is also pronounced zuò.
作.memory: Write the two-stroke person 亻 on the left, then the five-stroke 乍 on the right.

parts.label: 亻
parts.name: person component
parts.description: The first two strokes form 亻, the person component.

parts.label: 乍
parts.name: 乍 component
parts.description: The final five strokes form 乍 on the right.

試.note: 試 is fourth-tone shì. the conversation uses 試 in 試試看, 'give it a try / try and see what happens.'
試.memory: Build 言 on the left for speech, then 式 on the right; together they form 試.

parts.label: 言
parts.name: speech component
parts.description: The first seven strokes form 言 on the left.

parts.label: 式
parts.name: 式 component
parts.description: The final six strokes form 式 on the right.

難.note: 難 is second-tone nán. Before an action verb in this lesson, it means 'hard/difficult to': 難找 'hard to find', 難學 'hard to learn'.
難.memory: Build the eleven-stroke left side as 廿 above an interwoven 口 and 夫, then add the eight-stroke 隹 'short-tailed bird' on the right.

parts.label: 廿＋口／夫
parts.name: left structural component
parts.description: The first eleven strokes form the left side: 廿 above an interwoven 口 and 夫, matching the Traditional decomposition ⿱廿⿻口夫.

parts.label: 隹
parts.name: short-tailed bird component
parts.description: The final eight strokes form 隹 on the right.

u36-yihou-after.title: After an event with …以後
u36-yihou-after.pattern: Event / Time expression + 以後，Later event
u36-yihou-after.explanation: this lesson gives 以後 two functions. Unit 35 already taught standalone 以後 as a time word meaning 'in the future'. Here, an event or time expression comes before 以後: A + 以後 means 'after A' or 'later than A', and the later event follows. The rule here uses 回國以後, 來臺灣以後, 下課以後, and time expressions such as 半年以後.

examples.text: 我回國以後，也想找個有機會說中文的工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huíguó yǐhòu, yě xiǎng zhǎo ge yǒu jīhuì shuō Zhōngwén de gōngzuò.
examples.meaning: After I go back home, I would also like to find a job with opportunities to speak Chinese.

examples.text: 來臺灣以後，我每星期上五天的中文課。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, wǒ měi xīngqí shàng wǔ tiān de Zhōngwén kè.
examples.meaning: After coming to Taiwan, I have Chinese class five days a week.

examples.text: 我下課以後，常在圖書館上網。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàkè yǐhòu, cháng zài túshūguǎn shàngwǎng.
examples.meaning: After class, I often go online in the library.

examples.text: 半年以後，你打算做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Bàn nián yǐhòu, nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
examples.meaning: What do you plan to do half a year later?

u36-yihou-after.remember: Put the event or time anchor before 以後: 回國以後 = after returning home. Standalone 以後, already learned in Unit 35, means 'in the future'.

u36-hao-nan-verb.title: Special meanings of 好 / 難 + verbs
u36-hao-nan-verb.explanation: The rule here separates two uses. With perception verbs, forms such as 好吃/難吃, 好喝/難喝, 好看/難看, and 好聽/難聽 are single words describing a pleasant or unpleasant perception. With action verbs, 好 means 'easy to' and 難 means 'hard/difficult to': 好學/難學, 好寫/難寫, 好做/難做, 好找/難找. Degree adverbs such as 很 can modify either type. Negation puts 不 before the whole predicate (不好找, 不難學, 不好喝). Both branches can form 嗎 questions. For A-not-A questions, the source's perception example repeats the whole compound (好看不好看), while action-verb examples put the contrast before the action verb (好不好賣, 難不難學).

examples.meaning: Japanese food tastes good and also looks good.
Good jobs are hard to find.
This song is nice to listen to and easy to sing.

examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén juéde Zhōngwén hěn nán xué.
examples.meaning: Some people think Chinese is hard to learn.

examples.text: 學校附近便宜的套房不好找。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn piányí de tàofáng bù hǎo zhǎo.
examples.meaning: Cheap suites near the school are not easy to find.

u36-hao-nan-verb.remember: Perception branch: 好吃、好看, etc. are whole perception words; a source A-not-A form is 好看不好看. Action branch: 好 = easy to and 難 = hard to; ask 好不好 + V or 難不難 + V. Put 不 before the whole predicate in negatives.

u36-work-question.text: 你是什麼時候來臺灣工作的？
u36-work-question.pinyin: Nǐ shì shénme shíhou lái Táiwān gōngzuò de?
u36-work-question.meaning: When did you come to Taiwan to work?
u36-work-question.note: The rule here conversation includes the listener's name as a vocative before this question. Hanzi Steps omits the name here so the focus stays on the already-taught 是…的 question. 工作 is the verb 'to work' here; the vocabulary set also lists the same written form as the noun 'job, work'.

u36-last-year.text: 去年，我已經在臺灣工作一年了。
u36-last-year.pinyin: Qùnián, wǒ yǐjīng zài Táiwān gōngzuò yì nián le.
u36-last-year.meaning: Last year. I have been working in Taiwan for a year.
u36-last-year.note: This conversation Treat this as the conversation's duration-to-date statement; Unit 36 keeps it as conversation comprehension rather than declaring an additional duration grammar rule.

u36-tuition-question.text: 為什麼你們公司要替你付學費？
u36-tuition-question.pinyin: Wèishénme nǐmen gōngsī yào tì nǐ fù xuéfèi?
u36-tuition-question.meaning: Why does your company pay your tuition for you?
u36-tuition-question.note: the conversation retrieves 公司、替、付 and 學費 from Unit 35 before Tianzhong explains the business reason.

u36-business.text: 因為我們公司跟臺灣人做生意。
u36-business.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒmen gōngsī gēn Táiwān rén zuò shēngyì.
u36-business.meaning: Because our company does business with Taiwanese people.
u36-business.note: 生意 is new; 做 and 因為 are review. 做生意 is a transparent combination, not an extra new-vocabulary count.

u36-boss.text: 老闆希望我們都會說中文。
u36-boss.pinyin: Lǎobǎn xīwàng wǒmen dōu huì shuō Zhōngwén.
u36-boss.meaning: My boss wants us all to speak Chinese.
u36-boss.note: This conversation; 老闆, 希望, 都, 會, and 中文 are review.

u36-company-good.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐmen gōngsī zhēn hǎo.
u36-company-good.meaning: I think your company is really good.
u36-company-good.note: the conversation response. 覺得、公司 and 好 are review vocabulary.

u36-after-question.text: 對了，你回國以後，打算做什麼？
u36-after-question.pinyin: Duìle, nǐ huíguó yǐhòu, dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
u36-after-question.meaning: By the way, what do you plan to do after you go back to your country?
u36-after-question.note: The rule here prints a gender-specific form of 'you' for Yue-mei; Hanzi Steps uses the already-taught general pronoun 你 while preserving the sentence and grammar. 回國、打算 and 做 are review.

u36-after-home.text: 我回國以後，也想找個有機會說中文的工作。
u36-after-home.pinyin: Wǒ huíguó yǐhòu, yě xiǎng zhǎo ge yǒu jīhuì shuō Zhōngwén de gōngzuò.
u36-after-home.meaning: After I go back home, I would also like to find a job with opportunities to speak Chinese.
u36-after-home.note: This sentence uses 以後 after 回國 to mean 'after returning home'.

u36-after-taiwan.text: 來臺灣以後，我每星期上五天的中文課。

u36-after-class.note: this pattern example for Event + 以後.

u36-job-question.text: 不錯，這樣的工作在你們國家好找嗎？
u36-job-question.pinyin: Búcuò, zhèyàng de gōngzuò zài nǐmen guójiā hǎo zhǎo ma?
u36-job-question.meaning: Not bad. Is this kind of job easy to find in your country?
u36-job-question.note: the conversation introduces 這樣、國家 and the action-verb use 好找 'easy to find'.

u36-good-job.meaning: Good jobs are hard to find.
u36-good-job.note: this pattern example: 難 + action verb means 'hard to do'.

u36-try-it.text: 不知道好不好找，我試試看。
u36-try-it.pinyin: Bù zhīdào hǎo bù hǎo zhǎo, wǒ shìshi kàn.

u36-try-it.note: the conversation sentence. 試試看 is the listed phrase; it is taught as a transparent phrase built from new 試 and known 看.

u36-hard-find.meaning: What if it is hard to find?
u36-hard-find.note: the conversation. 難 + 找 means 'hard to find'. 要是 introduces the hypothetical condition; with sentence-final 呢, this asks 'what if...?' and leaves the consequence for the other speaker to supply, so no 就-clause is stated here.

u36-then.text: 那麼我再來臺灣學中文。
u36-then.pinyin: Nàme wǒ zài lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén.
u36-then.meaning: Then I would come back to Taiwan to study Chinese.

u36-see-again.text: 太好了！那我們就可以再見面了。
u36-see-again.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Nà wǒmen jiù kěyǐ zài jiànmiàn le.
u36-see-again.meaning: Great! Then we can see each other again.
u36-see-again.note: This completes the conversation. Here 那 is the short conversational 'then / in that case' leading into the result; compare new 那麼 in the previous turn. 太好了、就、可以、再、見面 are review.

u36-not-hard.text: 老師常常說中文不難學。
u36-not-hard.pinyin: Lǎoshī chángcháng shuō Zhōngwén bù nán xué.
u36-not-hard.meaning: The teacher often says Chinese is not hard to learn.
